messages.subject: Your witness statement — draft for review
messages.plaintextBody:
Liam,

Draft of your first witness statement is ready for review. The key paragraphs are: the commercial negotiation with Catherine Vane; the go-live sign-off by Aldous; the change in the relationship after Caldervale was acquired; and — most important — that no 30-day remedy notice was ever served and that the 14 June outage was their SSO. Please check every factual detail and let me have comments.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 1100
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
